content: Healthcare professionals should assist patients in managing stress effectively, as stress can significantly impact diabetes management and overall health. They should also focus on helping patients develop robust problem-solving skills to address challenges related to their condition. Additionally, it is essential to guide patients toward appropriate educational resources that can enhance their understanding of diabetes and its management. Emotional support should be provided to help individuals navigate barriers to self-care and to cope with the psychological and emotional demands associated with managing diabetes on a daily basis.
